description.value: You wrap yourself in a shimmering, Force-woven illusion that blurs and shifts your outline for the duration, giving any creature that attacks you disadvantage on the attack roll. An attacker unaffected by sight-based targeting, such as one with blindsight, or one able to see through illusions, such as with truesight, ignores this effect.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Universal Powers, Level 2
